zh.title: A2RT — 智能体实时多模态交互协议
zh.description: A2RT 连接智能体与实时环境。六条独立逻辑轨道，明确的执行回执，可扩展的环境 Profile。探索 0.2 草案、JSON Schema 与完整消息示例。
zh.hero_description: 声音、画面、事件，各有自己的节奏。A2RT 用一套通用协议，让智能体持续感知环境、发出操作，并获得真实的执行反馈。
zh.hero_note: 厂商无关 · 环境可扩展 · 异步多模态

zh.independent: 独立更新 / 因果关联
zh.console_caption: 点击轨道查看说明 · 时间仅作示意，不代表性能测量或固定频率

tracks.description: 智能体的声音独立流式交付；无需等待下一次操作，也不强制每条事件附带音频。
每个 output 恰好包含一个事件。Profile 决定发送窗口，连续操作可以有多个事件在途。
人的声音、其他参与者与设备音频独立到达，保留来源时钟和实际采样范围。
记录人或环境中已发生的事件。它们是观察到的事实，不应再次发送给执行器执行。
画面保留采集时刻和关联状态版本。视觉晚到时，已就绪的声音与回执仍可先交付。
承载真实执行回执、领域状态与播放进度。accepted 不等于成功，完成状态由执行器确认。

zh.strip_three: 就绪即交付，不等待全部模态
zh.protocol_title: 世界持续发生，交互也应如此。
zh.protocol_intro: 实时环境不会等待一次对话结束。A2RT 将感知、操作和反馈分开推进，同时保留它们之间的时间、来源与因果关系。

principles.title: 各自流动，局部同步
principles.body: 音频先到就先交付，画面晚到就保留真实时间。只有声明了依赖的声音和操作需要相互等待。

principles.title: 请求之后，必须有事实
principles.body: 事件描述想要做什么，回执说明实际发生了什么。通过 event_id 关联进展、失败和真实终态。

principles.title: 通用核心，具体环境
principles.body: Core 固定生命周期与交互语义。Profile 声明领域能力，Adapter 将能力映射到真实应用或设备。

zh.architecture_title:
一套核心，
连接不同环境。
zh.architecture_intro: 把稳定的交互规则留在核心，把领域差异交给明确的扩展层。为网页、协作画布、桌面与仿真环境定义各自的能力。
zh.architecture_link: 阅读核心与 Profile 规范
zh.architecture_note: 这些是协议可适配的环境方向；当前草案不包含已上线的领域适配器。

layers.name: A2RT Core
layers.subtitle: 定义交互的共同语言
layers.body: 统一消息、逻辑轨道、身份引用、来源时间、操作边界，以及执行回执和恢复语义。

layers.name: Environment Profile
layers.subtitle: 声明一个环境能做什么
layers.body: 注册自定义事件、状态 Schema、工具和具名执行策略。能力清单在 epoch 内冻结，并保留内容哈希。

layers.name: Adapter
layers.subtitle: 把请求变为真实执行
layers.body: 连接真实应用或设备，检查当前状态和权限，产生可信观察与执行回执。模型不能自证操作成功。

layers.name: Binding
layers.subtitle: 负责可靠、安全的交付
layers.body: 处理连接、鉴权、资源寻址和流控。具体传输绑定需要独立定义；使用 WebSocket 不自动代表兼容 A2RT。

zh.example_intro: 从一个非画布计数器环境入手，查看真实 fixture 中的输出、反馈与会话清单。示例可用仓库内校验器复核。

example_notes.title: 明确的来源与版本
example_notes.body: session_id、epoch 和 manifest_id 标识本次会话上下文；sent_at 保留来源时钟。

example_notes.title: 事件窗口与操作名额分开
example_notes.body: 同一次操作可以连续发送多个事件。收到首个真实回执释放事件窗口，真实终态才释放操作名额。

example_notes.title: 异步交付，持续关联
example_notes.body: 同一请求可以先收到 accepted，再收到 completed。每次进展都通过 event_id 与 revision 对账。

zh.faq_title:
开始之前，
你可能想知道。

faq.question: A2RT 现在可以直接用于生产吗？
faq.answer: 当前版本是 0.2 协议草案，交付包括规范、JSON Schema、消息示例和文档校验器。它不是生产 SDK，也尚未提供完整传输绑定或生产级执行器。

faq.question: 必须同时启用六条轨道吗？
faq.answer: 不需要。六条轨道是逻辑分类，按能力启用，并非六条连接。基础闭环需要 assistant.events，以及 environment.state 中分别承载 core.result 和 core.control_result 的 stream。

faq.question: A2RT 和 MCP 是什么关系？
faq.answer: MCP 可以作为工具接入方式之一，由适配器处理其握手、鉴权与调用。A2RT 负责实时环境的事件、媒体、观察和执行反馈；二者的映射需要明确设计，不能仅包一层 JSON 就宣称兼容。

faq.question: 协议保证固定帧率或毫秒级截止时间吗？
faq.answer: 不保证。A2RT 不固定帧率、采样率或全局时间窗口，也没有硬实时截止保证。实际时延、吞吐、媒体同步误差和恢复行为需要具体实现的工程验收。

zh.closing_title: 让下一次交互，有据可循。
zh.closing_body: 从协议草案开始，一起定义智能体与实时环境之间的连接。
zh.footer_note: 0.2 草案 · 规范、Schema 与可复核示例

en.title: A2RT — Agent-to-Real-Time Protocol
en.description: A protocol for agents interacting with real-time environments. Six independent logical tracks, explicit execution receipts, and extensible environment profiles. Explore the 0.2 draft.
en.hero_description: Audio, visuals, and events move at their own pace. A2RT gives agents a common protocol to observe, act, and receive truthful feedback from a changing world.
en.console_label: Interactive illustration of six logical tracks
en.select_track: Select a track to learn more
en.console_caption: Select a track to explore · Illustrative timing, not a performance benchmark

tracks.description: Agent audio streams independently. A chunk need not wait for an action, and an action need not carry audio.
Each output carries one event. A Profile defines the sending window; one operation may have multiple events in flight.
People, participants, and devices contribute audio with explicit source clocks and sample ranges.
Events that have already happened in the environment. These observed facts must never be executed again.
Visuals keep their capture time and source state references. Late visuals do not block ready audio or receipts.
Real execution receipts, domain state, and playback progress. Acceptance is not success; the executor confirms completion.

en.protocol_title: The world keeps moving. So should interaction.
en.protocol_intro: A real-time environment does not wait for a conversation turn to end. A2RT lets observation, action, and feedback progress independently, with time, provenance, and causality intact.

principles.title: Independent by default
principles.body: Deliver audio as it arrives. Preserve the timestamp of a late frame. Synchronize only the media and events with declared dependencies.

principles.title: Requests meet reality
principles.body: An event says what should happen. A receipt says what actually happened. Link progress, failures, and terminal outcomes through event_id.

principles.title: One core. Many environments.
principles.body: Core defines the lifecycle and interaction semantics. Profiles declare domain capabilities. Adapters connect them to real applications and devices.

en.architecture_title:
A shared foundation.
Room for your world.
en.architecture_intro: Keep stable interaction rules in the core, and domain differences in explicit extensions. Define capabilities for browsers, canvases, desktops, or simulations.
en.architecture_note: These are possible adaptation directions. The draft does not ship production adapters for these environments.

layers.name: A2RT Core
layers.subtitle: A common language for interaction
layers.body: Messages, logical tracks, identity references, source clocks, operation boundaries, execution receipts, and recovery semantics.

layers.name: Environment Profile
layers.subtitle: Declare what an environment can do
layers.body: Register domain events, state schemas, tools, and named execution policies. A manifest freezes capabilities and content hashes within an epoch.

layers.name: Adapter
layers.subtitle: Turn requests into real execution
layers.body: Connect to an application or device, check permissions and actual state, and report observations and execution receipts. An agent cannot certify its own success.

layers.name: Binding
layers.subtitle: Deliver reliably and securely
layers.body: Connections, authentication, media addressing, and flow control. Each transport needs an explicit binding; a WebSocket alone is not A2RT compatibility.

en.example_intro: Explore an output, feedback, and session manifest from the counter-environment fixture. Check the complete records with the repository validator.

example_notes.title: Identity and version, explicit
example_notes.body: session_id, epoch, and manifest_id identify the session context. sent_at preserves the source clock.

example_notes.title: Two separate limits
example_notes.body: Multiple events may belong to one operation. A first real receipt frees an event slot; a confirmed terminal state frees the operation slot.

example_notes.title: Asynchronous. Still connected.
example_notes.body: A request can receive accepted and later completed. Associate each update through event_id and a monotonically increasing revision.

faq.question: Is A2RT ready for production?
faq.answer: Version 0.2 is a protocol draft with a specification, JSON Schemas, fixtures, and a documentation validator. It is not a production SDK, transport binding, or complete runtime.

faq.question: Do I need all six tracks?
faq.answer: No. Tracks are logical categories, enabled by capability, not six separate connections. The baseline loop requires assistant.events and separate environment.state streams for core.result and core.control_result.

faq.question: How does A2RT relate to MCP?
faq.answer: MCP is an optional tool integration handled by an adapter. A2RT describes events, media, observations, and execution feedback in a real-time environment. A mapping needs explicit design; wrapping JSON does not establish compatibility.

faq.question: Does the protocol guarantee fixed latency?
faq.answer: No. A2RT specifies neither a fixed frame rate nor a global timing window, and provides no hard real-time deadline guarantee. Latency, throughput, synchronization error, and recovery need implementation-level validation.

en.closing_body: Start with the draft. Help shape the connection between agents and real-time environments.
